label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Ask a simple question
body: Encourage replies by asking a low-effort question that sparks conversation and helps you understand your audience better.
caption:
Sometimes the best way to connect with your audience is to simply ask them something. Instead of always sending information, try including a quick, easy-to-answer question in your next email. This helps people feel heard and gives you valuable insights into what they care about. Plus, it can make your emails feel more like a two-way chat. What's one thing you'd like to ask your subscribers?
